_note: Sakurazaka, the village's east part (added 2026-11-01): the road on from the village climbs east to the mine, lined with cherry trees, over a creek on a plank bridge (floor tiles over the water, stone lanterns at its ends). North of the road the Hanami teahouse (noren, raked gravel in front), Fumi's; south of the road Ichiro the charcoal burner's house with his firewood stacked by it (its door round the front: down the path at x 19, along y 16). Ichiro's charcoal kiln (kiln, 2 x 2) stands below his house, its mouth to the front, two thumbprints in the clay over it (his father's and his); beside it (cells 20-21 x 17-18) the new kiln grows with the story: kiln_site, a half-built mound of clay bricks with a pile and a shovel, once ichiro_kiln is set (heart_ichiro_5) and until ichiro_mark is (the prop's "unless"), then kiln_new, the finished kiln with Ichiro's thumbprint, and kiln_mark, the farmer's, once ichiro_mark is set (heart_ichiro_6); listed first so examining then reads their messages. A bamboo grove north-east of the creek, where Ichiro cuts wood. Format: README.md, Maps.
